entries.source: PANGERL, Goldenkron (=FRA II/37, Wien 1872) S. 145-147, 1375 I 21
entries.german:
Abt Gerhart und der Convent zu Goldenkron überlassen gemäss dem Spruche genannter Schiedsieute und auf Bitten des Pfarrers Wenzel zu Černitz diesem jene zwei Feldstücke, welche bisher zwischen ihnen strittig gewesen, zu lebenslänglicher Nutzniessung.

Nos dominus Gerhardus abbas, Herman(n)us prior et Herman(n)us subprior simul et Gerhardus senior monasterii Sanctae Coronae ordinis Cisterciensis diocesisque Pragensis, ne nostrae devotionis actio hominum vergat in oblivionem una cum temporum defluxu, recognoscimus tenore praesentium universis praesentibus et futuris, quod postquam domino Venceslao ecclesiae in Czernitcz capellano nostro agros quosdam, videlicet agrum inter viam quae ducit in Praynstan 1, et aliam viam quae ducit,in Ssczekrz 2, ipsis viis contigue adhaerentem, item agrum inter pratum ecclesiae ipsius supinum (supravium) et metas agrorum curiae nostri monasterii collocato (sic, collocatum) 3, qui ad nos nostrumque monasterium videntur legittime pertinere, saepe et saepissime ad resignandum nobis extorquendo monuissemus, sed volentes cum eo graves materias disceptationum suffocare elegimus nobis viros discretos atque maturos, dominum Hostislaum decanum Dudlebensem plebanumque in Crumpnav, dominum Nicolaum plebanum in Prziedol 4, dominum Johannem praedicatorem Teutonicorum similiter in Crumpnaw 5, nec non discretum virum Swatomirum clientem de Brziezie 6 iudices et arbitros nobis vigorosos, quibus dedimus per tenorem praesentem parte ex utraque plenariae potestatis autoritatem (sic) de alto et basso inter nos et materiam litis nostrae vim decernendi, sententiandi et sententiam pronuntiandi. Ex quorum quidem virorum honorabilium prout praescribuntur arbitrorum nostrorum sententiae pronuntiatione, quam in nos grate atque firme suscepimus, promittentes eidem pronuntiationi sine dolo parte ex utraque obedire, nos praelibati dominus Gerhardus abbas totusque prout praescribimur monasterii Sanctae Coronae conventus praenotatos agros concessimus gratiose atque dimisimus benivole ad humilem supplicationem ipsius praescripti domini Venceslai nostri capellani, ex pronuntiatione arbitrorum praedictorum usque ad tempus vitae suae libere tenere ac possidere, ipsi promittentes saepe nominatos agros ab eo non repetere nec extorquere quovis iure, quoadusque praetactus dominus Venceslaus suos dies clauserit extremos. In cuius rei testimonium nos saepetactus dominus Gerhardus abbas totusque simul conventus nostris sigillis appensis de nostra certa scientia iussimus literas praesentes confirmare. Datum et actum anno domini millesimo trecentesimo septuagesimo quinto, duodecimo Kalendas mensis Februarii.
entries.english:
Abbot Gerhard and the convent of Goldenkron grant to Wenzel, the parish priest of Černitz, for his lifetime the use and possession of two fields that had previously been in dispute between them, in accordance with the decision of the named arbitrators and at the priest’s request.

We, Lord Gerhard, abbot, Hermann, prior, Hermann, subprior, and Gerhard senior of the monastery of the Holy Crown, of the Cistercian order and the Diocese of Prague, lest the act of our devotion pass into oblivion with the passage of time, make known by this present document to all now living and to come that, after we had repeatedly and insistently urged our chaplain, Lord Wenzel of the church at Černitz, to surrender to us certain fields which appear rightfully to belong to us and our monastery—namely, the field between the road leading to Praynstan and another road leading to Ssczekrz, adjoining both roads, and the field situated between the church’s sloping meadow (above the road) and the boundary markers of our monastery’s farm—we, wishing to put an end to the serious grounds for dispute with him, chose as judges and arbiters with full authority the prudent and mature men Lord Hostislav, dean of Dudleby and parish priest at Krumlov; Lord Nikolaus, parish priest at Přídolí; Lord Johann, preacher to the Germans, likewise at Krumlov; and the prudent man Swatomir, retainer of Brziezie. By this present document we gave them full authority on both sides, in all matters, to decide, judge, and pronounce judgment on the dispute between us and the subject of our litigation. In accordance with the decision pronounced by these honorable arbitrators, which we have gratefully and firmly accepted, and promising to obey that decision on both sides without deceit, we, the aforesaid Lord Gerhard, abbot, and the whole convent of the monastery of the Holy Crown, have graciously granted and willingly released the aforesaid fields to the said Lord Wenzel, our chaplain, to hold and possess freely until the end of his life, promising not to reclaim or demand the said fields from him under any right until the aforesaid Lord Wenzel has reached the end of his days. In witness of this, we, the aforesaid Lord Gerhard, abbot, and the whole convent have ordered this present charter to be confirmed with our seals attached, with our certain knowledge. Given and done in the year of the Lord 1375, on the twelfth day before the Kalends of February.
